entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return something. This is absolutely ridiculous. I've been a customer for years and the quality has gone straight downhill.
I'm very sorry to hear that you're not satisfied. I can certainly look into a return for you. Can I get your name and order number, please?
The name is Mark Peterson. Order number is VF789012. I bought this ClubFit jersey and it's the wrong size. It's way too tight, I can barely get it on.

Okay, thank you, Mark. I'm pulling up your order now... I see the jersey was delivered about two months ago. What specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault with the material or more of a preference on the fit?
It's not a preference, it's defective! The sizing is a complete lie. This is not a Medium. Are you going to help me or do I need to speak to your manager? I will light you up on social media.
I understand your frustration, and there's no need to speak to a manager, I can definitely help you with this. Let me just confirm our policy. One moment.
Unbelievable. Just figure it out. I want a refund or an exchange. Now.

Thank you for your patience. I've checked the policy, and you are well within our 90-day return window. We can absolutely get this sorted out for you. I can either process a full refund or an exchange for a different size.
Oh. So you're actually going to do it? No hassle?
No hassle at all. We want to make sure you have gear that fits you perfectly. Would you prefer the refund, or would you like to do an exchange for a larger size?
Fine. The design of the jersey is fine, it was just too tight. Let's do an exchange for a Large.

Excellent. I have processed the exchange for a size Large. A prepaid return label is on its way to your email right now. Just use that to send back the original jersey, and we'll get the new one sent out.
You're very welcome, Mark. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
